passage: Dear Diary, Today started with a special assembly at school. We had a foreign visitor from Australia who came to talk about communication in English. She explained the English alphabet with interesting stories, which made it easier to remember for my upcoming exam. In the afternoon, I had my weekly horse-riding lesson. My instructor said I'm improving, and we practiced jumping over small obstacles. It's my favourite hobby! Later, I went to the local supermarket. There was a discount on fresh fruit, so I bought some apples and oranges. The sign said there was a minimum spend of £5 to get the discount, but I was buying enough anyway. I also picked up a new book on art, as I'm interested in that too. On the way back, I saw some rubbish near the park and decided to pick it up. It's important to keep our neighbourhood clean. Overall, it was a productive day with learning and fun. Best wishes, Sam
